Charming traditional house Vietnamese restaurant

Great Food, Disappointing Service
Jul 2026 • Solo
First, I had the banana flower salad with chicken. It was fresh, and the vegetables were thinly sliced. The dressing was savory and gave the dish a bright, refreshing flavor. I felt that all the ingredients worked harmoniously together, and the combination of textures made it enjoyable to eat. Next, I tried the prawn stewed in a claypot with starfruit. This was a comforting, home-style dish that really captured the essence of Vietnamese home cooking. The prawns were firm and juicy, while the sauce was rich, flavorful, and well-balanced. The starfruit blended naturally into the sauce. Overall, it was a very satisfying dish. Lastly, I had the lá lốt wrapped beef. Unfortunately, this was the weakest dish of the meal. The beef was overcooked, making it less tender than it should have been. It was also under-seasoned, so without the accompanying dipping sauce, it tasted bland. However, what disappointed me the most was the service. One of the dishes I ordered, sương sâm, was never served. I waited for 30 minutes before deciding to pay the bill and leave. I was surprised that a restaurant with so many staff members could overlook such a basic part of the dining experience.

Cosy Atmosphere, Great Food! Just Watch the Extra Charges
Apr 2026 • Family
Cuc Gach Quan offers a beautifully cosy and homely dining experience, with an atmosphere that immediately makes you feel comfortable and relaxed. The interior has a charming, lived-in feel that adds to the authenticity of the restaurant.

The food was plentiful and enjoyable, with generous portions that make it great for sharing. Service was also a standout, attentive, friendly, and efficient without being overbearing.

The only surprise was the additional charges at the end of the meal. Alongside a 10% fee, there was an extra 8% tax that wasn’t clearly explained, which was a bit confusing.

Overall, it’s a lovely spot with great food, excellent service, and a warm atmosphere, just worth being aware of the extra charges when you dine.

A Vietnamese restaurant with a homely feel that happened to make great food
Aug 2025 • Friends
It was a great find in what I would consider up the main road. The restaurant was set up like a traditional Vietnamese family home with great wooden features, a fish, pond, stocking Koi and catfish outfront and meal served in what I would expect to see in a regular house. The meals were presented well and paid homage to the cooking of the Vietnamese. It was a great family or friend environment. The only point I like to mention is that some of the steps into the establishment and within the establishment are quite high and people in wheelchairs or have a walking impairment may struggle but these too can be worked around.
